Frequently Asked Questions

Is ITU better than UET Taxila?

Both Information Technology University Punjab and University of Engineering & Technology Taxila are HEC-recognized universities. ITU is public (est. 2012) in Lahore, while UET Taxila is public (est. 1975) in Taxila. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between ITU and UET Taxila?

ITU's fee is approximately Rs. 1.95–2.25L/sem per semester, while UET Taxila's is Rs. 30–50K/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for ITU and UET Taxila?

ITU: UG (CS/AI): 50% Academic + 50% Test (min 50% test score). Engineering: 50% Academic + 50% ECAT/Test. MS varies — interview component added.. UET Taxila: 60%+ FSc, ECAT.
